Players Committee card image of [[Odd Ball's Torrent Starfighter]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 1 clone pilot. Odd Ball deploys -1 aboard. While Odd Ball piloting, power and hyperspeed +1, and adds one destiny to total power. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 while Odd Ball piloting).” Uploaded unchanged.
